defects: The produced statement quantifies over ALL immersions g inside the RHS of the iff (`∀ g, IsImmersion g → ContMDiff g → ContMDiff (g∘f)`), rather than fixing a single given C^n immersion φ as an external hypothesis of the theorem the way the gold does (φ is an implicit variable with hφ : IsImmersion J J' n φ, so the iff is proven for an arbitrary but fixed immersion). This changes the logical content: gold's backward direction only needs ONE immersion's composition to be C^n to conclude f is C^n, which is a much stronger/more useful fact than needing ALL immersions' compositions to be C^n as required by the produced version.

The immersion in the produced statement maps N → N (an endomorphism of the same manifold), not into a distinct 'further manifold' N' as explicitly stated in the informal statement and as present in the gold (φ : N → N', with separate model J' and manifold N'). This drops the generality of composing with an immersion into a different target manifold.

Because IsImmersion in the produced statement is apparently not parametrized by the smoothness degree n (unlike gold's IsImmersion J J' n φ), an extra separate hypothesis ContMDiff I' I' n g had to be added; combined with the universal quantification defect, the overall proposition is not equivalent to the gold's fixed-immersion characterization.
